category: file host (free, anonymous uploads, REST API)

free_tier.stated: Up to 10 GB per file; files that get no downloads within 35 days are deleted; no file type is blocked.
free_tier.notes: No total storage figure is printed.

per_object_cap.stated: Up-to 10GB, subject to be changed without any prior notice if it gets abused, or we decide to increase it.
per_object_cap.notes: bytes = 10 x 1024^3; the vendor may change the cap without notice.

retention.stated: As long as files have downloads it will be kept as long as the site is running. Files that do not get downloads within 35 days will get deleted.
retention.notes: The 35 days restart with each download.

egress.terms: No download allowance printed; registered users get view and download counts.

interface_detail: The FAQ says an API exists for uploading files and managing folders; the API documentation page was not read.
tooling: REST API per the FAQ; the API page was not read.
chaining: 10 GB anonymous uploads kept as long as they are downloaded at least once in 35 days: a download counter keeps a file alive.

limits.value: 10 GB per file, changeable without notice
deleted after 35 days with no download

binding_note: A file nobody downloads within 35 days is deleted, which bounds how long an upload can be left unattended.

identity_cost.detail: The FAQ states 'Anonymous uploads cannot be manually deleted', so anonymous upload exists; registered users get a dashboard and password protection.

reliability_note: No paid tier page was found: the /pricing URL answered HTTP 404 on 2026-11-03.
confidence_note: FAQ read on 2026-11-03. Paid tier unverified: no price page exists at /pricing.
